finding.summary: XSS in Bleach when noscript and raw tag whitelisted

verdict.reasoning: The advisory states bleach.clean is vulnerable to mutation XSS when both 'noscript' and a raw tag (title, textarea, script, style, noembed, noframes, iframe, xmp) are in the allowed tags list. The application's TAGS list in notes/render.py explicitly includes both 'noscript' and 'style' (one of the listed raw tags), and render_note calls bleach.clean(html, tags=TAGS, attributes=ATTRS, strip=False) with exactly this configuration. This function is reached from the Flask PUT /notes/<slug> endpoint (notes.web:save), which passes raw, externally-controlled request body data through markdown.markdown then bleach.clean before storing it, and the rendered note is later served via the GET /notes/<slug> endpoint. This is a direct, unauthenticated, attacker-reachable path exercising the exact vulnerable configuration described in the advisory.

evidence.explanation: TAGS whitelist includes both 'noscript' and 'style', matching the advisory's vulnerable combination (noscript + a raw tag).
bleach.clean is called with this TAGS list and strip=False, exercising the vulnerable mutation-XSS code path.
The PUT /notes/<slug> route passes unauthenticated, external request body data into render_note, which flows into bleach.clean.
The GET /notes/<slug> route later serves the bleach-sanitized (but still mutation-XSS-vulnerable) HTML to other clients, completing the attack surface.

package: bleach
summary: XSS in Bleach when noscript and raw tag whitelisted
affected: >=0, <3.1.1

GHSA-q65m-pv3f-wr5r (bleach) details:
### Impact

A [mutation XSS](https://cure53.de/fp170.pdf) affects users calling `bleach.clean` with `noscript` and a raw tag (see below) in the allowed/whitelisted tags option.

### Patches

v3.1.1

### Workarounds

* modify `bleach.clean` calls to not whitelist `noscript` and one or more of the following raw tags:

```
title
textarea
script
style
noembed
noframes
iframe
xmp
```

* A strong [Content-Security-Policy](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/CSP) without `unsafe-inline` and `unsafe-eval` [`script-src`s](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Content-Security-Policy/script-src)) will also help mitigate the risk.

GHSA-m6xf-fq7q-8743 (CVE-2020-6816)
package: bleach
summary: Bleach vulnerable to mutation XSS via whitelisted math or svg and raw tag
affected: >=0, <3.1.2

GHSA-m6xf-fq7q-8743 (bleach) details:
### Impact

A [mutation XSS](https://cure53.de/fp170.pdf) affects users calling `bleach.clean` with all of:

* the `svg` or `math` in the allowed/whitelisted tags
* an RCDATA tag (see below) in the allowed/whitelisted tags
* the keyword argument `strip=False`

### Patches

Users are encouraged to upgrade to bleach v3.1.2 or greater.

### Workarounds

* modify `bleach.clean` calls to use `strip=True`, or not whitelist `math` or `svg` tags and one or more of the following tags:

```
script
noscript
style
noframes
xmp
noembed
iframe
```

* A strong [Content-Security-Policy](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/CSP) without `unsafe-inline` and `unsafe-eval` [`script-src`s](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Content-Security-Policy/script-src)) will also help mitigate the risk.
